* Script `QIF_IN_eta_generation.m` generates eta from Lorentzian distribution and saves as `time_series_rand/eta_N%d_%d.txt`; 

* Program `qif_in_micro.c` load generated eta distribution from `time_series_rand/eta_N%d_%d.txt` and integrates this network;
  Compile:  gcc -O3 -march=native -fopenmp -o qif_in qif_in_micro.c -lm *
  Usage:
           ./qif_in <N> <run_index>
           e.g.: ./qif_in 100000 1

* Script `run_all_time_series_generation.sh` runs simulations in batches;

* Script `optimization/QIF_IN_DiffEvolution.py` infere parameters using signal generated by `qif_in_micro.c` simulation.
It needs compiled `losslib.c` version (see README.txt file in `Supplementary_note_2/QIF_AD_Noninvasive` folder);

* Results are polotted by matlab script `results_plot.m`
